name: Bali
source:
The uke protagonist of the story!
He passes his days beta-testing games closed in his lonely house and looking down on human race.
Being a rebel and wanting to disappoint his family whenever he could, he chose to adopt a transgressive style wearing just a very short hoodie with a devil-like tail, make-up and he even had implemented two subcutaneous horn-like piercings on his forehead.
His only nourishment consists in instant ramen enriched with surimi.
translation:
The uke protagonist of the story!
He passes his days beta-testing games closed in his lonely house and looking down on human race.
Being a rebel and wanting to disappoint his family whenever he could, he chose to adopt a transgressive style wearing just a very short hoodie with a devil-like tail, make-up and he even had implemented two subcutaneous horn-like piercings on his forehead.
His only nourishment consists in instant ramen enriched with surimi.
